guidance.bestFor: A name on the left and its percent on the right, over a bar left at the active style's default height

whenNotToUse.when: A bar that must stay 4px thin whatever the active style

guidance.bestFor: A slim bar pinned to a 4px track, whatever height the active style gives it by default
A heavy bar pinned to a 12px track, with its name and percent on the row above
A bar that fills by itself and loops, with a status line under it that rewords as each cutoff is passed
agentNotes: `downloadTimer` is a `setInterval` that adds 1 to 4 points every 150ms and loops to 0; set `downloadProgress` from your real task
`getStatusMessage` maps fixed percent cutoffs to install copy such as Extracting files; rewrite the stages and wording for your task

whenNotToUse.when: A bar the user sets by dragging, with no timer moving it

name: c-progress-5
title: File upload list with progress & status.
label: File Uploads
description: File upload list with progress & status.

guidance.bestFor: Rows of 4 files, each with a file icon, a cut off name, a 4px bar and the time left or Complete at the end
agentNotes: Replace `files`; each `progress` and `status` is fixed, and `status` holds both the time left and the Complete label
`ItemTitle` takes a pointer cursor and hover underline but has no link or handler, so wrap the name in a link or drop those classes

whenNotToUse.when: Rows that mark each document by format with a colored PDF or XLSX icon
A queue that also collects the documents the user drops or picks

guidance.bestFor: A bar and a 0 to 100 slider under it with a step of 1, both bound to one value state
agentNotes: `onValueChange` returns an array because `Slider` gets `value` as an array, and `setValue` stores it whole; store its first item so `Progress` gets a number

whenNotToUse.when: An input the user drags to choose a level, with no task to report

guidance.bestFor: A setup checklist whose bar fills by the share of finished steps, with a done count and a check or empty circle per step
agentNotes: Replace `steps`; the bar and the count come from each `completed` flag, and nothing in the example marks a step done
`progressValue` turns the done count into a percent; keep it, since the radix bar reads its value as a percent and ignores a max prop

whenNotToUse.when: Steps the user clicks through, each opening its own panel of content

guidance.bestFor: Stacked bars in 5 fixed palette fills from green to violet that all slide from 45 to 75 together on load
agentNotes: All 5 bars read one `progress` state that a `setTimeout` moves from 45 to 75 once after 500ms; give each bar its own value
Each fill is a fixed palette class such as `bg-green-500` on the `progress-indicator` slot, so it stays the same in every theme and in dark mode

whenNotToUse.when: A single bar that advances by itself with a status line that rewords
